name: Laskovyj dozhd'
source:
The weekend has come, and Verta goes for a walk by the sea with her melancholy brother Robert and her restless sister Mimi. Soon they all have to learn a lot about ghosts, parents, witches and mirrors. Until the memories are washed away by the gentle summer rain.

[Translated from [url=https://agamichrono.itch.io/sofr]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
周末到了，维尔塔与忧郁的兄弟罗伯特、活泼好动的姐妹咪咪一同去海边散步。很快，他们将了解到许多关于幽灵、父母、女巫与镜子的事，直到记忆被温柔的夏雨冲刷而去。

[译自[url=https://agamichrono.itch.io/sofr]itch.io[/url]]
